Hi Sarah / Tom — happy to confirm the specifics below. Short version up front: yes, hosted trial/org logs include requests and responses by default and are retained 30 days; customers can disable logging or choose Dedicated/Private for full control. Details: 

Hosted API (default behavior)
- What is stored: request metadata (timestamps, client IPs), full request payloads (prompts), and model outputs are logged for debugging, billing reconciliation, and quality monitoring.
- Retention: default retention window is 30 days; after 30 days logs are purged automatically.
- Use cases for logs: troubleshooting, safety/abuse detection, and product analytics.
- Opt-out: workspace-level logging can be disabled for customers on the Hosted plan by toggling "store request/response logs" in org settings; opt-out removes stored payloads from our debug logs going forward but does not retroactively purge logs already aged past retention.

Dedicated / Private Deployment
- What is stored: logs are configurable. For Dedicated (Redwood-managed but reserved capacity) we can disable request/response payload logging per contract; for Private (VPC/on-prem) logs and retention are under customer control and can be configured to not persist payloads outside your environment.
- Data residency: deployments can be provisioned in specific cloud regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1) and logs remain in the selected region. Private installs remain fully customer-controlled.

PII-specific controls
- Redaction & masking: we offer automated PII redaction rules that can be applied to logs (e.g., redact SSNs, credit card numbers, email addresses) prior to storage. This can be enabled on the org or request level.
- Encryption: logs and artifacts are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). We support KMS integrations for Dedicated/Private.
- Audit & access: access to stored logs is role-based and logged via our audit trails; we can provide read-only access to sanitized logs for customer security teams.

Retention & deletion
- Default: 30 days for request/response payloads on Hosted.
- Configurable: retention windows are configurable for Dedicated contracts (e.g., 7/30/90/365 days) and can be negotiated in the SOW for Private deployments.
- Deletion: customers can request expedited purge of their org's stored logs; for Hosted customers we perform purge within 72 hours of an approved request (subject to legal/contractual hold exceptions).

Other notes
- Embeddings: if you use embedding/semantic search features, embedding vectors and associated metadata are stored only if you opt in for indexing; retention for embedding indexes is configurable and typically separate from request/response logs.
- Billing/metrics: non-sensitive billing metrics (token counts, costs) are retained longer for invoicing purposes, but payloads are still subject to the retention policy above.

I attached our short policy summary (redwood-pii-policy.pdf) and a link to the full docs: https://redwood.example.com/security/pii-handling. If you want, Marissa and I can join the tech validation call and walk through a demo of turning off logging and enabling redaction on the org.
